records.provenance: COD 2311041; published monoclinic WO3 neutron-diffraction structure, Acta Crystallographica (1966)
Ordered NiWO4 wolframite analogue derived from ambient MgWO4 COD 9013902 and the published NiWO4 lattice of COD 5910277
records.transformation: Replaced Mg by Ni in the ordered P2/c MgWO4 model, retained its fractional coordinates and symmetry, and set a=4.600 A, b=5.665 A, c=4.912 A, beta=90.5 degrees from published NiWO4 COD 5910277; no coordinate fitting introduced. The legacy NiWO4 CIF explicitly duplicates symmetry-equivalent sites and is not used directly.
